name: application-saved-views-bar
title: Saved Views Bar
description: Row of named saved views (persisted filter/sort presets) with add, rename, and star affordances — distinct from tabs, which switch content panes rather than a saved query.
useWhen: Letting users save and switch between named filter or sort presets on a list or table.
Surfacing a favorited/starred view alongside other saved views.
Offering a quick 'save current filters as a view' action next to existing presets.
avoidWhen: The items switch between different content panes rather than re-querying the same view — use application-tabs instead.
There is only one possible view — a saved-views row adds UI for a choice that doesn't exist yet.
Views need deep hierarchical organization (folders/groups) — this is a flat single-row list only.
responsiveBehavior: The underline variant scrolls horizontally if the views overflow their container; the pill variant wraps onto multiple lines on narrow screens.
accessibility: The row carries role='tablist' and each view carries role='tab' with aria-selected reflecting the active view.
The active view's options control is a separate real button from the selection button, not a nested interactive element.
The star/favorite icon is decorative; the view's visible label is what identifies it to assistive technology.

variants.title: Underline views
variants.description: Underline-style row of saved views with a trailing button to save the current filters as a new view.
accessibility: The active view is marked with aria-selected='true' in addition to the underline indicator.

variants.title: Underline views (Dark)
variants.description: Underline-style saved views row adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: The underline indicator and active text color must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Pill views with star and options
variants.description: Pill-style saved views with a starred/favorite indicator and a separate options button on the active view, plus a dashed 'New view' affordance.
accessibility: The selection button and the options button are two separate real button elements, not a button nested inside a button.

variants.title: Pill views with star and options (Dark)
variants.description: Pill-style saved views bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active and inactive pill contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
